scope: Test-only regression for process-bound refusal before acquisition of a fork-inherited locked keyring mutex

boundary.held_lock: Parent holds the keyring mutex across an actual fork and bounded child join.
boundary.child_refusal: Public synchronous and asynchronous preparation both raise KeyUnavailable before inherited mutex acquisition.
boundary.child_positive: A fresh local development provider and prepared lease seal/open synthetic text.
boundary.parent_positive: After child exit and lock release, both retained prepared keys and ring preparation open the original parent frame.
boundary.cleanup: Join is bounded to 5 seconds. Finally closes parent pipe endpoints and kills/reaps a live child with another bounded join. The lock context releases on every outcome. Pipe capture contains only fixed status bytes and is bounded to 128 bytes.

review: Lead independently reviewed the new test before the single wrapper run. No fabricated RED or product source correction was needed for this implemented boundary.
preflight: The single wrapper run reloaded both private URL files and passed both mandatory role probes. No credentials or URLs are recorded here.
limits: No persistent or production custody decision
No independent-process recovery of lost ephemeral wrapping keys
